messages:
alex: :rotating_light: Observing persistent 504s from hosted inference gateway in us-west-2. Tickets from two customers reporting timeouts and partial responses. Opening thread to coordinate. Support ticket #12345 and #12382.
maria: Thanks. Do we have a quick repro or a curl we can give CS for temporary mitigation?
jordan: Putting the minimal repro we used locally:
```bash
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{"input":"long prompt repeated to hit >1024 tokens","max_tokens":512}' \\
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/hosted/generate
```
Response hangs then 504 after ~30s. No consistent error body.
sam: Metrics: increased egress queue depth on gateway pods starting ~2026-03-17T09:12Z, per-route p50 latency up from 80ms->450ms, p95 spiking to 2.3s. Backend inference pool showing KV cache stall errors in logs.
alex: Any deploys around that time?
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout for model-quantize-x v2 completed at 2026-03-17T09:10Z (canary 10% traffic)
maria: Canary could be related. Jordan, can you paste the gateway logs for one of the 504s (request id)?
jordan: Paste of gateway logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T09:13:04Z] request_id=req-8f3a upstream_timeout=true backend=hosted-inference-1 route=/v1/hosted/generate queue_ms=1200 kv_cache_retry=1 error=\"upstream timeout\"
[2026-03-17T09:13:04Z] inference-worker-7: kv_cache_miss_count=47 stall_ms=4500
```
maria: Looks like KV cache misses + stall -> inference worker blocked, upstream timed out. Could be quantized kernel regression in canary causing slower KV loads.
sam: Immediate mitigation options: 1) scale inference pool + add capacity in us-west-2, 2) initiate fallback to previous non-quantized model variant, 3) route traffic to eu-west for affected requests (customers ok with region?).
alex: Quick execution: jordan, flip canary back (rollback) and remove model-quantize-x v2 from canary. Sam, scale pool + bump pod concurrency. Maria, tell CS to apply client-side retry/backoff and give curl repro for support.
jordan: Rolling back canary now. deploy-bot: Rollback started for model-quantize-x v2 -> completed at 2026-03-17T09:18Z :thumbsup:
sam: Scaled worker pool + increased reserved concurrency on us-west-2. Queue depth returning to normal after ~90s.
maria: Notifying customers: CS sent temporary mitigation steps (retry/backoff, fallback endpoint option). Customer A confirmed reduced client errors after retry policy applied.
alex: Good. Action items to capture here for post-incident follow-up:
- owner: jordan (runtime) - root cause analysis of quantized kernel interaction with KV cache
- owner: sam (eng-sre) - adjust autoscaling thresholds to detect KV stall-driven latency earlier
- owner: maria (support) - draft customer-facing postmortem and update runbook for retry guidance
- owner: alex (prod) - evaluate canary rollout gating for inference models (add KV/cold-cache benchmarks)
(all due EOD+3)
maria: Also include a test harness that simulates long prompts + cold KV cache to catch this in CI.
jordan: Agree. I'll add a synthetic workload and stress test to the canary pipeline.
ops-bot: incident-bot: Incident resolved at 2026-03-17T09:20Z. Creating follow-up ticket INF-2026-102 in backlog.
alex: Thanks everyone. We'll schedule a 30-min postmortem sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. Please add notes to INF-2026-102 before the meeting.
maria: Adding timeline and customer impact summary now.
sam: I'll attach autoscaler graphs and pod-level metrics.
jordan: I'll include the failing kernel profiling results and the rollback diff.
alex: Closing thread for now — keeping INF-2026-102 as the canonical follow-up. :white_check_mark:
